oneLiner: Multi-repo catalog sync: ingest partner feeds to S3, normalize in worker, publish events, reconcile inventory across API and search index.
requirementSummary: Spec catalog-sync-v3 §2–§6: scheduled + manual ingest, idempotent processing, dead-letter queue, webhook to partners on publish, search index eventual consistency within 5 minutes, feature-flagged rollout.

integration.summary: catalog-api exposes ingest triggers and read API; catalog-worker pulls from S3, writes Postgres `catalog_items`, emits `catalog.published` to Kafka; catalog-search consumer updates OpenSearch; partner webhooks signed with HMAC; object-store lifecycle for raw feeds.

agentConsiderations.question: Synchronous ingest API vs queue-only?
agentConsiderations.resolution: API writes manifest + S3 pointer; worker async per §4.2—API stays under 2s.

agentConsiderations.question: Dual-write search vs event-driven?
agentConsiderations.resolution: Kafka-only to search; API never touches OpenSearch (prior incident HOT-991).

agentConsiderations.question: Split worker MR from API MR?
agentConsiderations.resolution: Three MRs: api #501, worker #502, search #118—merge order enforced in brief.

agentConsiderations.question: At-least-once Kafka vs exactly-once?
agentConsiderations.resolution: At-least-once + idempotent upsert keys; search consumer uses external versioning.

worthMentioning: §6.4 full bi-directional sync deferred—this MR is ingest → publish only.
DLQ topic `catalog.ingest.dlq` must be monitored before prod flag on.
OpenSearch reindex NOT required if mapping version unchanged (see migration note).
Worker MR #502 must deploy before enabling `catalog.sync_v3_enabled`.

humanValidation.headline: Treat as a system: confirm three MRs, idempotent ingest, search lag, and webhook signatures—not just catalog-api diff.
correctSignals: Re-running same feed file produces no duplicate sellable rows (unique partner_sku + tenant).
After publish event, search finds SKU within SLA (staging test ≤5 min).
Poison message lands in DLQ without blocking partition.
Webhook retries exponential backoff; signature header documented.
Feature flag off: legacy ingest path still works.
redFlags: Missing merge order: search consumer deployed before worker emits new schema.
No DLQ or silent drop on parse errors.
Raw PII from partner feed logged at INFO.
Single MR claims all three services without sibling links.

deepDives.title: Why Kafka between worker and search
deepDives.body: Decouples indexing spikes from ingest; replays reindex without re-reading S3. Incident HOT-991 taught us not to dual-write OpenSearch from API.

humanChecklist: Sibling MRs #502 #118 reviewed or merged per order
Webhook signature doc shared with partners
